name: Moving Items
description: Items move by belts, chutes, funnels and arms.

pages.title: Moving Items
pages.text: Items move by **belts**, **chutes**, **funnels** and **arms**. Machines pick up what is on the belt in front of them.

pages.title: Mechanical Belt
pages.text: Needs rotation. Carries items and entities. Place two shafts, link them with the belt, and machines can work on items riding it.

pages.title: Depot
pages.text: A stationary belt tile. Items sit on it, and a press, deployer or spout above can work on them.

pages.title: Brass Funnel
pages.text: Pulls from or pushes into an inventory. Place normally to pull, sneaking to push. Has a filter slot. The Andesite Funnel moves items unfiltered.

pages.title: Chute
pages.text: Drops items down. Needs no power. The **Smart Chute** adds a filter slot and extraction size.

pages.title: Mechanical Arm
pages.text: Assign input and output blocks by right-clicking them while holding the arm, then place it. Moves items between any inputs and outputs in range.
**Filters**: the **List Filter** matches chosen items, the **Attribute Filter** matches by property (food, enchanted, and so on). Put them in funnel, tunnel or smart chute filter slots.

pages.title: Brass Tunnel
pages.text: Covers a belt and splits items to the sides, or sorts them by filter. Andesite Tunnels split one item at a time without filters.

**Storage**: the **Item Vault** is a big multi-block chest that connects to belts and funnels. A **Threshold Switch** reads how full a container is and outputs redstone.

For networks that deliver by package, see [#](2E5AAC)[Logistics](entry://create_basics/packages)[#]().
